stronger_left_out_note: Threshold: every non-kept candidate with 5,000+ English Wikipedia views (lowest kept score is 0 views, so all 1+ view candidates are technically stronger; the rest are small local parks/venues/memorials recorded with reasons in verdicts.json and skeptic.json).
